#### What type of PR is this?
This PR addresses the failing test cases in the Eviction manager when `dedicatedImageFs` is set to `true`. It updates the test case setup to align with the correct configuration, ensuring that the tests pass successfully under this condition.
/kind cleanup
/kind feature
<!--

/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This PR updates the test case setup in the Eviction manager to handle the scenario where dedicatedImageFs is set to true. Previously, all test cases assumed that dedicatedImageFs was false, leading to failing tests in that configuration. By making these changes, we ensure that the tests pass successfully when dedicatedImageFs is set to true

issue_context.title: eviction_manager has no test paths with dedicatedImageFS set to true.
issue_context.body:
Eviction manager has logic in case of a user having a separate disk for images from node.

Reading the test cases we always set up a MockStatsProvider with `dedicatedImageFs` set to false.  

We should enable test cases with `dedicatedImageFS` set to true.  

```golang
				diskInfoProvider := &mockDiskInfoProvider{dedicatedImageFs: false}
```

All the cases that set this to false mean that we are testing the case where NodeFs and ImageFS are on the same disk.

/kind feature
/help
/sig node
